# <span class="hero-highlight">Hey there, I’m Ford!</span>

:::

I’m a data analyst and storyteller with a background in sociology and criminology, skilled at finding patterns in messy datasets. Teaching myself R sparked my passion for turning data into relatable stories.

Beyond the digital world, you’ll often find me outdoors, capturing moments through my camera lens, hitting the trails for a hiking adventure or learning how to golf.

Take a look around my site to explore my work, dive into my projects, and get a glimpse of my journey with data.

:::

:::
